description: Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Energy Highlights is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment", published or maintained by IEA (International Energy Agency (IEA)). The database is subject to the IEA’s Terms and Conditions, available at This free extract from Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Energy (previously called CO2 Emissions from Fuel Combustion) contains an extensive selection of Greenhouse gas emissions data from the energy sector for over 190 countries and regions. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in HTML. The portal files it under Environment. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is restricted or on request according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is other closed licence (terms not stated in the catalogue entry). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
